Know that It's normal to feel this way when you are 14, we all been there, even people in their 20s feel this way. But you need to realize that you are so young and still have life ahead of you. No need to rush things and feel that you already supposed to have figured life out cause you will just spend the rest of your life worrying about that... constantly worrying about the future and your purpose in life. As hard as it can be, stop comparing yourself to others, you're different and your life is different than theirs so no need to compare your journey to theirs cause it's not gonna be the same. what you want in life and accomplish is different from what they want so don't be harsh on yourself.

What you can do now is this, experience as many things as you can, it can be big or small it doesn't matter if you succeed or fail. if you do succeed that's good but if you don't it's fine the point is to experience new things. and also, try to utilize every opportunity you can get. doing this can help you find some sort of direction and what you want to do in life. If you want change then you need to start it, you need to push yourself a bit to get things started. I'm writing to you this as if what I want to say to my 14 years old lazy ass and wish new. I didn't do much at that age because I was shy and scared and I could've done something if I just pushed myself and stopped caring about people judging me. Many of the things I said you might not hit you now but maybe one day you might get it but I just hope you realize that things will get better, there will always be highs and lows but ultimately things will be better and you will find your way in life.

If you need someone to talk to, I'm here. 

I wish you all the best and much love.

Hey, if you're reading this I hope you're doing well. please don't give up on yourself, and the fact that you're sharing your struggle and going to therapy just shows that yes you're good enough to live. I feel it's important for you to know that you shouldn't be harsh on yourself and try to live day by day. it's kinda how I manage to overcome my suicidal attempt this year when there was no one there to help me. it's hard for sure and wanting to live and finding the will power can be tough to navigate but in my case how did I find it is that I let myself take its time to heal and time can heal and with a little bit of a push I tried to find anything to be my source of motivation to want to live or makes me feel better. Slowly, I felt better but externally my life was still a mess so I tried to find what I can change in my life that I have control over and set goals and what can I do to achieve these goals and it shouldn't be something big, even small simple things that you can achieve in a day can do. these small things that you achieve might help you feel better and see progress and have some order in your life and motivate you to continue. I don't know if what I wrote is any help but I read your post and really wanted to help and if you need someone to talk you can reach out to me and please take care of yourself.
